scope: Every source ayah, with no length, score, or highlight exclusion.

addressable.meaning: Canonical locus present and unique; lookup roundtrips.

parsed.meaning: JSON source text and locus parsed; no claim of linguistic completeness.

analyzed.meaning: SDK analyze completed, including zero-transition and missing-feature cases.

detected.meaning: At least one typed transition detected under the supplied feature projection.

visualized.meaning: Per-locus browser rendering explicitly verified in this pass; no browser was run.

audioVerified.meaning: Recitation/audio comparison explicitly verified; no audio verification performed.

assumptions: Only independently sourced supplied morphology is projected to surface tokens; withheld alignment and ambiguous fields remain missing.
No grammatical-person value establishes a speaker identity.
Transitions compare adjacent source tokens inside each ayah; this pass does not carry state across ayah boundaries.
Visualized and audioVerified counts are evidence from this pass, not the UI addressable capacity.
